Configuration and settings

The Configuration tree

Below the space in the Tandem container, the Configuration view manages Claude Code configuration per scope (project or user): hooks, commands, skills, agents, MCP servers, permissions, and installed plugins — with add / open / delete from the tree and its context menus. The view follows your active project.

Choosing the repository

Tandem never assumes which folder of a multi-root workspace you mean. The active repository is chosen once and remembered per workspace:

  • the status-bar item Tandem: <repo>;

  • the <repo> ▾ button in the map;

  • Tandem: Switch Project / Repository in the command palette.

Each repository has its own session and its own space in the store.

Settings

Setting Default Meaning

thinkubeTandem.storeRoot

~/thinkube-tandem-store

Root of the store; spaces persist at <root>/spaces/<repo>.

thinkubeTandem.groundingModel

opus

Model for the derivation rounds (judgment work).

thinkubeTandem.workerModel

sonnet

Base model for run workers — never inherited from the environment.

thinkubeTandem.workerModelByRole

{}

Per-role raises, e.g. {"judge": "opus"}.

thinkubeTandem.maxConcurrent

4

Concurrent workers on the run’s ready frontier.

thinkubeTandem.suiteCommand

npm test

The project’s test suite; its verdict is a delivery proof.

thinkubeTandem.docsGateMode

blocking

Governs Gate 2 (Accept) only: whether an unmet documentation obligation blocks accepting, or is advisory. It does not excuse Gate 1 (Sign) — signing always requires documentation or a written exemption, whatever this setting is.

thinkubeTandem.giteaToken

empty

API token for a Gitea forge (github.com remotes use the gh CLI instead).
